context: Zhang [23] (Theorem 21) showed an upper bound on the quantum bounded error communication complexity of f ◦ XOR in terms of the approximate weight and the F2 -degree of f . Theorem 12 shows that the dependence on the F2 -degree is not required when f is symmetric, even for classical bounded error complexity. This shows the tightness of Theorem 19 for symmetric XOR functions. We leave the reader with two open questions. Is the lower bound of Theorem 19 tight for all XOR functions? In particular, a positive answer would verify the Log Approximate Rank Conjecture for all XOR functions. It is well-known [16] that the real degree of a boolean function is polynomially related to its approximate degree. Does a similar relationship carry over to the spectral norm? Theorem 9 gives a positive answer for symmetric functions.
